department: Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics

deadline.value: December 15, 2026 for applicants seeking financial support (full consideration). International applicants not seeking support can apply until May 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: For those who are applying for financial support, all applications are due by December 15, 2026 to receive full consideration

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required for Fall 2027 but you may submit a score.
gre_general.quote: For Spring 2027/Fall 2027 applications, the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test is NOT required. However, you are most welcome to submit your GRE score should you have it.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the department pages checked

supervisor.value: The admissions committee reviews applications and the program director admits students into one of five tracks; no advisor is needed in advance.
supervisor.quote: Upon the recommendation of the Admissions Committee, the Graduate Program Director will authorize an offer of admission to either our M.S. or Ph.D. program with an initial placement in one of the department's five graduate tracks.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are considered for financial support if they apply by the funding deadline; support is not stated as guaranteed.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the doctoral program will automatically be considered for financial support if the application is submitted by the due date for financial support.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in mathematics, a natural science, engineering, an applied science or a social science with strong mathematics is the stated minimum.
entry_route.quote: A. A bachelor's degree in mathematics, a natural science, engineering, an applied science, or a social science with a strong mathematics background.

notes: Five graduate tracks; applicants pick at least one on the supplement. The department page still quotes the old TOEFL scale (90); the university record gives the current scale. Data Science PhD is a separate joint AMS/CS program.
